models.description: Flagship pick for careful English and German writing, translation, and proofreading: strong instruction following and long-form consistency. Expect ~9 GB on disk and higher RAM use than 8B options—use Qwen 3 8B or Ministral 3 8B if your machine is tighter. May occasionally show brief reasoning-style traces before the final answer; prefer direct replies for polished copy.
models.license_note: Apache-2.0 — Qwen3; see Alibaba model card on Hugging Face.

models.description: Google's current mid-size instruct model with clear, safe answers and solid EN/DE quality—good when Qwen 3 14B is too heavy. Replaces Gemma 2 9B with a newer generation at a similar download size (~7 GB).
models.license_note: Gemma license — see Google Gemma terms on Hugging Face model card.

models.description: Efficient 8B instruct with strong multilingual behavior and disciplined replies—suitable for everyday correction and translation when you want lower latency and ~5 GB downloads than the 14B flagship. May occasionally show brief reasoning-style traces.
models.license_note: Apache-2.0 — Qwen3; see Alibaba model card on Hugging Face.

models.description: Recommended starting model: Mistral's current 8B instruct checkpoint with crisp answers and reliable EN/DE for drafting and translation-style prompts. Successor to Mistral 7B v0.3 with stronger multilingual support.
models.license_note: Apache-2.0 — see Mistral model card on Hugging Face.

models.description: Open-weight reasoning-style model distilled from DeepSeek-R1 into the Qwen-7B architecture: strong math, logic, and step-by-step answers. Replies often include a visible chain-of-thought style trace before the final answer—great for analysis, awkward for polished prose; prefer Ministral 3 or Qwen 3 Instruct when you want clean copy.
models.license_note: MIT — DeepSeek R1 distill; base Qwen license applies; see Hugging Face model cards.
